moduleDoc:
NFT Property Deed & Legal Title Binding Contract.

Binds fractional ERC-20 style asset tokens to a single master NFT
representing the legal deed title stored in municipal land registries.

# Architecture

- The master NFT (token_id `0`) represents the legal deed title.
- While fractional tokens are actively trading, the master NFT is
  locked in a vault contract.
- To unlock and transfer the master NFT, 100% of the fractional tokens
  must be redeemed (burned) back to the asset-token contract.
- Once all tokens are redeemed, the NFT can be transferred to the
  redeemer, completing the legal title transfer.

# State machine

```text
Locked ──100% redemption──► Unlocked ──transfer_nft──► Transferred
```

methods.name: initialize
methods.doc: Initialize the NFT deed contract.  - `admin`              — contract administrator. - `fractional_token`   — the fractional asset-token contract address. - `vault`              — the vault contract where the NFT is locked. - `deed_uri`           — URI of the legal deed document (e.g. IPFS). - `registry_id`        — municipal land registry identifier. - `beneficiary`        — the address that can claim the NFT upon full                          redemption of all fractional tokens.

methods.name: owner_of
methods.doc: Returns the owner of the given token ID.  While the NFT is locked, the owner is the vault contract. After unlocking, the owner is the beneficiary who redeemed all tokens.

methods.name: transfer_nft
methods.doc: Transfer the master NFT to a new owner.  Can only be called when the NFT is unlocked (all fractional tokens have been redeemed). The caller must be the current owner.

methods.name: token_uri
methods.doc: Returns the metadata URI for the given token ID.  This URI points to the legal deed document stored in the municipal land registry (or an IPFS mirror of it).

methods.name: redeem_and_unlock
methods.doc: Redeem fractional tokens to unlock the master NFT.  The caller specifies how many fractional tokens they are redeeming. Once the cumulative redeemed amount reaches 100% of the original total supply, the NFT is unlocked and can be transferred to the beneficiary.  This function: 1. Burns the specified amount of fractional tokens from the caller. 2. Tracks cumulative redemptions. 3. If 100% redeemed, unlocks the NFT and assigns ownership to the    beneficiary.

methods.name: is_unlocked
methods.doc: Check if the master NFT is unlocked (all fractional tokens redeemed).

methods.name: fractional_token
methods.doc: Returns the bound fractional asset-token contract address.

methods.name: registry_id
methods.doc: Returns the municipal land registry identifier.

methods.name: fractional_total_supply
methods.doc: Returns the original total supply of fractional tokens at binding time.

methods.name: current_fractional_supply
methods.doc: Returns the current total supply of fractional tokens.

methods.name: version
methods.doc: Current contract ABI version, polled by the off-chain indexer.
